parameters.name: AppKey
parameters.description: The key of the application that is used to make an API call.

parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application. The name must be 4 to 26 characters in length. The name can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_), and must start with a letter.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the application. The description can be up to 180 characters in length.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag of objects that match the rule. You can specify multiple tags.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi create-app --app-name CreateAppTest --description test --tag Value=example-string Key=env --app-key 60030986 --app-secret nzyNqFkRWB2uLw86 --app-code 3aaf905a0a1f4f0eabc6d891dfa08afc --extend 110210264071 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi CreateApp --region cn-hangzhou --AppCode 3aaf905a0a1f4f0eabc6d891dfa08afc --Tag.1.Key env --Description test --Extend 110210264071 --AppKey 60030986 --Tag.1.Value 'example-string' --AppSecret nzyNqFkRWB2uLw86 --AppName CreateAppTest
